landing.headline: Training that adapts to you
landing.body: Answer a few questions and get a workout for every day — built around your goals, your schedule, your equipment and how your last session actually went.

step1.title: Answer nine questions
step1.body: Goal, days, equipment, injuries, experience. About three minutes.

step2.title: Get every day planned
step2.body: Gym days built from a split or from the muscles you choose. Runs paced from your own times.

step3.title: Log it, and the plan learns
step3.body: Tap sets as you go, even offline. Next week's volume and weights come from what you actually lifted, and how hard it felt.

programs.title: Choose what you train
programs.body: Pick a split, or name the muscles for each day. Any day can be rebuilt on the spot.
programs.legs: Quads, hamstrings, glutes and calves in one session.
programs.glutes_hamstrings: A glute day with hamstring support.
programs.upper: The whole upper body in one go.

run.title: Run too
run.body: Easy, long and interval runs paced from your own times, and repaced every time you run faster. 5K, 10K or half marathon.

why.title: Built for your first week and your fifth year

safe.title: Safe starts
safe.body: Beginners start lighter, on machines, with two reps in reserve. Health answers make the first weeks careful.

progress.title: Real progression
progress.body: Rate how hard each set felt and the next load follows. A lighter week every fourth, or sooner if a lift stalls, sleep goes or something hurts.

gear.title: Your body, your gear
gear.body: Injuries remove movement patterns, not the session. No rack? No problem.

group.title: Train together, keep it private
group.body: Groups see names, sessions done and streaks. Never your weights or body data.

cta.title: Your plan is nine questions away
cta.body: No password, no card. A sign-in link by email and you are in.

footer.madeFor: Made for phones. Add it to your home screen and it works offline in the gym.

demo.title: Try it right now
demo.body: Pick the muscles and your level. The session below is built by the same engine as the app, here in your browser, with no sign-up.
demo.note: Example loads for a {kg} kg athlete. Yours come from your own weight, then from every set you log.

coach.title: A coach in your pocket
coach.body: Every day starts with three taps: sleep, soreness, energy. The session bends to the answer.

disclaimer.short: General training guidance, not medical advice.
disclaimer.long: Hyex gives general training and nutrition guidance. It is not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Talk to a doctor before starting hard training, especially if you have a health condition or any symptoms.

notes.estimateOnly: These are estimates to start from, not medical advice. Adjust them to how you feel and how your training goes.
notes.noDeficitUnder18: You are under 18, so this plan does not use a calorie deficit.
notes.conservativeMode: Your health answers put you in a careful start, so this plan does not use a calorie deficit.
notes.calorieFloorApplied: This has been raised to a safe minimum rather than going lower.
notes.disorderedEating: You told us about a history of disordered eating, so this plan never uses a deficit. Train for strength; eat to fuel it.
notes.rateCapped: The change has been capped at a safe weekly rate.
notes.adaptedUp: Your two-week trend moved faster than planned, so the target has come up a little.
notes.adaptedDown: Your two-week trend is slower than planned, so the target has come down a little.
notes.recompPatience: Recomposition is slow by design: eat at maintenance, lift hard, judge by the mirror and the bar over months, not the scale over days.

auth.magicLinkHint: The link works once and expires after an hour. Open it on this same device and browser.
auth.checkEmailBody: We sent you a sign-in link. Open it on this device to continue.
auth.checkEmailSpam: If it has not arrived in a minute, check your spam folder.

errors.invalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
errors.sendFailed: We could not send the link. Try again in a moment.

errors.linkInvalid: That link did not work. Ask for a new one.
errors.signedOut: You have been signed out. Sign in again to continue.
errors.rateLimited: Too many links requested for now. Wait a little while and try again, or use the link you already received.

auth.startFreeHint: No link to click. Your plan is saved on this device, and you can add an email later to keep it.
auth.orEmail: Or sign in with an email

phase.calibration: Finding your weights this week. Leave two reps in the tank on every set.
phase.build: One heavy set, then back-offs. This is where the progress comes from.
phase.intensify: Hardest week of the block. Push the last set of the day.
phase.deload: Deload. Light and easy on purpose — you are recovering, not slacking.

readiness.good: You are fresh. Full session today.
readiness.moderate: A bit flat. Same work, slightly lighter.
readiness.low: Rough day. Shorter session, lighter weights — showing up is the win.

review.struggling: Tough week — only {done} of {planned} sessions happened. I have trimmed next week so you can finish it.
review.grinding: You were grinding. Same weights next week, a bit less of them.
review.thriving: That looked easy — {done} of {planned} done and well within yourself. Stepping it up.
review.onTrack: {done} of {planned} sessions done. Right where you should be — same again.

back_squat.name: Back squat
back_squat.cue1: Brace your trunk before you descend
back_squat.cue2: Push the floor away, knees tracking over toes
back_squat.cue3: Sit between the hips, not onto the knees
back_squat.step1: Bar on the upper back, feet shoulder width, toes slightly out.
back_squat.step2: Brace, then sit down between the hips until the thighs pass parallel.
back_squat.step3: Drive the floor away and stand tall, knees tracking over the toes.

front_squat.name: Front squat
front_squat.cue1: Elbows high, bar resting on the shoulders
front_squat.cue2: Stay upright all the way down
front_squat.cue3: Elbows high or the bar rolls forward
front_squat.mistake1: Elbows dropping and the bar rolling forward
front_squat.step1: Bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows high, fingertips under it.
front_squat.step2: Sit straight down with the torso upright until the thighs pass parallel.
front_squat.step3: Drive up keeping the elbows up the whole way.

goblet_squat.name: Goblet squat
goblet_squat.cue1: Hold the weight against your chest
goblet_squat.cue3: Elbows inside the knees at the bottom
goblet_squat.mistake1: Leaning forward as you go down
goblet_squat.step1: Hold one dumbbell vertically against the chest, feet shoulder width.
goblet_squat.step2: Sit down between the heels, chest up, until the elbows meet the knees.
goblet_squat.step3: Push the floor away to stand.

leg_press.name: Leg press
leg_press.cue1: Lower until your thighs meet your torso
leg_press.cue2: Keep your lower back on the pad
leg_press.cue3: Lower back stays glued to the pad
leg_press.mistake1: Locking the knees at the top
leg_press.mistake2: Letting the hips roll off the seat
leg_press.step1: Feet shoulder width in the middle of the platform, back flat on the pad.
leg_press.step2: Lower the sled until the knees are near ninety degrees without the hips rolling.
leg_press.step3: Press through the whole foot; stop just short of locking the knees.

hack_squat.name: Hack squat
hack_squat.cue1: Shoulders under the pads, feet mid-platform
hack_squat.cue2: Control the descent, drive up through the whole foot
hack_squat.step1: Shoulders under the pads, feet mid platform, back flat.
hack_squat.step2: Lower under control until the thighs pass parallel.
hack_squat.step3: Drive up without locking the knees hard at the top.

bulgarian_split_squat.name: Bulgarian split squat
bulgarian_split_squat.cue1: Rear foot on the bench, front foot a long stride ahead
bulgarian_split_squat.cue2: Drop straight down, front shin near vertical
bulgarian_split_squat.cue3: Most of the weight stays on the front foot
bulgarian_split_squat.mistake1: Standing too close to the bench
bulgarian_split_squat.step1: Back foot on a bench, front foot a long stride ahead.
bulgarian_split_squat.step2: Lower straight down until the back knee is near the floor.
bulgarian_split_squat.step3: Drive up through the front foot without bouncing off the back leg.

walking_lunge.name: Walking lunge
walking_lunge.cue1: Long step, back knee toward the floor
walking_lunge.cue2: Torso tall, drive through the front heel
walking_lunge.cue3: Step long enough that the front shin stays vertical
walking_lunge.mistake1: Short steps that jam the front knee
walking_lunge.step1: Stand tall with dumbbells at the sides.
walking_lunge.step2: Step forward and lower until both knees are near ninety degrees.
walking_lunge.step3: Drive through the front foot and step straight into the next rep.

step_up.name: Step-up
step_up.cue2: Push through the top leg, not the bottom one
step_up.cue3: Put the whole foot on the box
step_up.step1: Stand in front of a knee-high box or bench.
step_up.step2: Place the whole foot on it and stand up without pushing off the floor leg.
step_up.step3: Lower slowly, controlling the descent with the top leg.

bodyweight_squat.name: Bodyweight squat
bodyweight_squat.cue2: Sit back and down, chest up
bodyweight_squat.cue3: Reach the arms forward for balance
bodyweight_squat.step1: Feet shoulder width, toes slightly out, arms in front.
bodyweight_squat.step2: Sit down between the hips as deep as you can control.
bodyweight_squat.step3: Stand back up through the whole foot.

reverse_lunge.name: Reverse lunge
reverse_lunge.cue1: Step back and lower the rear knee
reverse_lunge.cue3: Push through the front heel to return
reverse_lunge.step2: Step one foot back and lower the back knee toward the floor.
reverse_lunge.step3: Drive through the front foot to bring the feet together.

leg_extension.name: Leg extension
leg_extension.cue2: Pause for a second at the top
leg_extension.cue3: Pause at the top and squeeze
leg_extension.mistake2: Lifting the hips off the seat
leg_extension.step1: Sit with the pad on the shins and the knees in line with the pivot.
leg_extension.step2: Extend the legs until they are straight and pause.
leg_extension.step3: Lower slowly without letting the stack touch down.

conventional_deadlift.name: Deadlift
conventional_deadlift.cue1: Bar over mid-foot, shins to the bar
conventional_deadlift.cue2: Push the floor away, keep the bar close
conventional_deadlift.cue3: Bar stays in contact with the legs
conventional_deadlift.mistake2: Jerking the bar off the floor
conventional_deadlift.step1: Feet hip width, bar over the midfoot, grip just outside the legs.
conventional_deadlift.step2: Brace, pull the slack out and stand up with the bar dragging the shins.
conventional_deadlift.step3: Lock out by squeezing the glutes, then hinge back down.

romanian_deadlift.name: Romanian deadlift
romanian_deadlift.cue1: Soft knees, push the hips back
romanian_deadlift.cue2: Lower until you feel the hamstrings, then stand
romanian_deadlift.cue3: Stop when the hamstrings pull, not when the bar reaches the floor
romanian_deadlift.mistake1: Bending the knees into a squat
romanian_deadlift.mistake2: Bar drifting away from the legs
romanian_deadlift.step1: Stand tall with the bar at the hips, knees soft.
romanian_deadlift.step2: Push the hips back and slide the bar down the thighs.
romanian_deadlift.step3: Drive the hips forward to stand, squeezing the glutes.

dumbbell_rdl.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
dumbbell_rdl.cue2: Hinge at the hips, flat back
dumbbell_rdl.cue3: Dumbbells slide down the front of the legs
dumbbell_rdl.step1: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at the thighs.
dumbbell_rdl.step2: Push the hips back, dumbbells tracking down the legs, back flat.
dumbbell_rdl.step3: Drive the hips forward to stand.

leg_curl.name: Leg curl
leg_curl.cue2: Squeeze at the top, control the way back
leg_curl.cue3: Hips stay down on the pad
leg_curl.step1: Lie face down with the pad above the heels.
leg_curl.step2: Curl the heels toward the glutes as far as they go.

nordic_curl.name: Nordic curl
nordic_curl.cue1: Hips straight, lower as slowly as you can
nordic_curl.cue3: Hips open the whole way down
nordic_curl.step1: Kneel with the ankles anchored, hips extended.
nordic_curl.step2: Lower the torso forward as slowly as you can, hands ready to catch.
nordic_curl.step3: Push off lightly and pull yourself back up.

hip_thrust.name: Hip thrust
hip_thrust.aliases: barbell hip thrust, glute bridge with bar
hip_thrust.cue1: Shoulder blades on the bench, chin tucked
hip_thrust.cue2: Drive up until the hips are level, squeeze
hip_thrust.cue3: Chin tucked, ribs down at the top
hip_thrust.mistake1: Overarching the lower back at the top
hip_thrust.step1: Upper back on a bench, bar over the hips, feet flat.
hip_thrust.step2: Drive the hips up until the body is a line from shoulders to knees.
hip_thrust.step3: Lower under control without resting at the bottom.

dumbbell_hip_thrust.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
dumbbell_hip_thrust.cue2: Pause at the top for a second
dumbbell_hip_thrust.step1: Upper back on a bench, a dumbbell across the hips.
dumbbell_hip_thrust.step2: Drive the hips up until the thighs are level with the torso.

glute_bridge.name: Glute bridge
glute_bridge.cue2: Squeeze the glutes, not the lower back
glute_bridge.cue3: Squeeze the glutes, not the lower back
glute_bridge.mistake2: Not going all the way up
glute_bridge.step1: Lie on your back with the knees bent and feet flat.
glute_bridge.step2: Drive the hips up until the body is a straight line.

cable_kickback.name: Cable kickback
cable_kickback.cue1: Slight forward lean, hold the frame
cable_kickback.cue3: Squeeze at the top, no arch
cable_kickback.step1: Attach the cuff to the ankle and hold the frame.
cable_kickback.step2: Kick the leg straight back by squeezing the glute.

hip_abduction.name: Hip abduction
hip_abduction.cue3: Lean forward slightly to hit the upper glute
hip_abduction.step1: Sit with the pads outside the knees.
hip_abduction.step2: Push the knees apart as far as they go and pause.

single_leg_glute_bridge.name: Single-leg glute bridge
single_leg_glute_bridge.step1: Lie on your back, one foot flat, the other leg raised.
single_leg_glute_bridge.step2: Drive the hips up through the planted heel.
single_leg_glute_bridge.step3: Lower slowly and keep the hips level throughout.

standing_calf_raise.name: Standing calf raise
standing_calf_raise.step1: Balls of the feet on the step, shoulders under the pads.
standing_calf_raise.step2: Lower the heels until the calves are fully stretched.
standing_calf_raise.step3: Rise as high as possible and pause.

dumbbell_calf_raise.name: Dumbbell calf raise
dumbbell_calf_raise.cue1: Toes on a step for range
dumbbell_calf_raise.cue3: Hold the top for a second
dumbbell_calf_raise.mistake2: Leaning on the wall too much
dumbbell_calf_raise.step1: Stand on a step holding a dumbbell, heels hanging off.
dumbbell_calf_raise.step2: Lower the heels until you feel a full stretch.
dumbbell_calf_raise.step3: Rise onto the big toe and pause.

bodyweight_calf_raise.name: Calf raise
bodyweight_calf_raise.cue1: Rise as high as you can
bodyweight_calf_raise.step1: Stand with the balls of the feet on a step or the floor.
bodyweight_calf_raise.step2: Rise as high as you can and pause.
bodyweight_calf_raise.step3: Lower slowly to a full stretch.

bench_press.name: Bench press
bench_press.cue1: Shoulder blades pulled together, feet planted
bench_press.cue2: Bar to the lower chest, press up and slightly back
bench_press.mistake1: Bouncing the bar off the chest
bench_press.step1: Lie with the eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pulled back and down.
bench_press.step2: Lower the bar to the lower chest with the elbows at about forty-five degrees.
bench_press.step3: Press back up to lockout over the shoulders.

dumbbell_bench_press.name: Dumbbell bench press
dumbbell_bench_press.cue3: Dumbbells travel in a slight arc
dumbbell_bench_press.mistake1: Clanging the dumbbells at the top
dumbbell_bench_press.step1: Lie on a flat bench with the dumbbells over the chest.
dumbbell_bench_press.step2: Lower until the elbows are just below the bench.
dumbbell_bench_press.step3: Press up and slightly together without clanking.

incline_dumbbell_press.name: Incline dumbbell press
incline_dumbbell_press.cue3: Bench at thirty degrees, no higher
incline_dumbbell_press.step1: Set the bench to a low incline and sit with the dumbbells at the shoulders.
incline_dumbbell_press.step2: Lower under control until the upper arms are just below the bench.
incline_dumbbell_press.step3: Press up over the upper chest.

chest_press_machine.name: Chest press machine
chest_press_machine.cue2: Squeeze the chest at the end
chest_press_machine.cue3: Shoulder blades stay against the pad
chest_press_machine.step1: Set the seat so the handles line up with the mid chest.
chest_press_machine.step2: Press forward until the arms are almost straight.
chest_press_machine.step3: Return slowly, keeping the shoulders back.

push_up.name: Push-up
push_up.cue2: Chest to the floor, elbows tucked
push_up.cue3: Elbows at forty-five degrees, not flared
push_up.step1: Hands slightly wider than the shoulders, body in one line.
push_up.step2: Lower the chest to the floor keeping the hips level.
push_up.step3: Press back up to full extension.

cable_fly.name: Cable fly
cable_fly.cue2: Bring the hands together in front of the chest
cable_fly.step1: Stand between the pulleys with a handle in each hand and a slight lean forward.
cable_fly.step2: Bring the hands together in front of the chest in a wide arc.
cable_fly.step3: Open slowly until you feel the chest stretch.

dumbbell_fly.name: Dumbbell fly
dumbbell_fly.cue2: Stop when you feel the stretch
dumbbell_fly.cue3: Stop when the chest stretches, not when the shoulder hurts
dumbbell_fly.mistake2: Bending the elbows into a press
dumbbell_fly.step1: Lie on a bench with the dumbbells above the chest, elbows slightly bent.
dumbbell_fly.step2: Open the arms in a wide arc until the chest is stretched.
dumbbell_fly.step3: Squeeze the chest to bring them back together.

overhead_press.name: Overhead press
overhead_press.cue1: Bar at the collarbones, glutes tight
overhead_press.cue2: Press straight up, head through at the top
overhead_press.cue3: Push the head through at the top
overhead_press.step1: Bar on the front of the shoulders, grip just outside the shoulders, glutes tight.
overhead_press.step2: Press straight up, moving the head back slightly to clear the bar.
overhead_press.step3: Lock out overhead, then lower to the shoulders.

dumbbell_shoulder_press.name: Dumbbell shoulder press
dumbbell_shoulder_press.cue2: Press until the arms are straight
dumbbell_shoulder_press.step1: Sit tall with the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
dumbbell_shoulder_press.step2: Press up until the arms are straight, not touching the dumbbells.
dumbbell_shoulder_press.step3: Lower under control to the shoulders.

machine_shoulder_press.name: Machine shoulder press
machine_shoulder_press.step1: Set the seat so the handles start at shoulder height.
machine_shoulder_press.step2: Press overhead until the arms are nearly straight.

pike_push_up.name: Pike push-up
pike_push_up.cue1: Hips high, head toward the floor
pike_push_up.cue2: Press back up to the start
pike_push_up.cue3: Head travels forward of the hands
pike_push_up.step1: Start in a push-up position and walk the feet in until the hips are high.
pike_push_up.step2: Bend the elbows and lower the head toward the floor in front of the hands.
pike_push_up.step3: Press back up to the pike.

lateral_raise.name: Lateral raise
lateral_raise.cue2: Raise to shoulder height, lead with the elbows
lateral_raise.step1: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides.
lateral_raise.step2: Raise the arms out to shoulder height with a slight bend in the elbows.

face_pull.name: Face pull
face_pull.aliases: rope face pull, rear delt pull
face_pull.cue2: Pull to the face, elbows high and wide
face_pull.cue3: Pull to the forehead, elbows high
face_pull.step1: Set a rope at face height and step back with the arms extended.
face_pull.step2: Pull toward the forehead, spreading the rope and pointing the elbows out.

rear_delt_fly.name: Rear delt fly
rear_delt_fly.cue3: Lead with the elbows, not the hands
rear_delt_fly.step1: Hinge forward with a dumbbell in each hand hanging below the chest.
rear_delt_fly.step2: Raise the arms out to the sides, elbows soft.

barbell_row.name: Barbell row
barbell_row.cue2: Pull to the lower ribs, squeeze the back
barbell_row.cue3: Torso stays at the same angle for every rep
barbell_row.step1: Hinge to about forty-five degrees with the bar hanging at the knees.
barbell_row.step2: Pull the bar to the lower ribs, elbows driving back.
barbell_row.step3: Lower under control without standing up.

dumbbell_row.name: Dumbbell row
dumbbell_row.cue1: Hand and knee on the bench
dumbbell_row.cue2: Pull to the hip, not the shoulder
dumbbell_row.cue3: Pull to the hip, not the shoulder
dumbbell_row.step1: One hand and knee on a bench, the other foot on the floor, back flat.
dumbbell_row.step2: Row the dumbbell to the hip, elbow close to the body.
dumbbell_row.step3: Lower slowly until the arm is straight.

chest_supported_row.name: Chest-supported row
chest_supported_row.step1: Lie face down on an incline bench with the dumbbells hanging.
chest_supported_row.step2: Row the dumbbells up, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
chest_supported_row.step3: Lower slowly to a full stretch.

seated_cable_row.name: Seated cable row
seated_cable_row.cue2: Pull to the stomach, elbows back
seated_cable_row.step1: Sit tall with the feet on the platform and the handle in both hands.
seated_cable_row.step2: Pull the handle to the lower ribs, elbows close.
seated_cable_row.step3: Return slowly until the arms are straight.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat pulldown
lat_pulldown.cue1: Grip a bit wider than the shoulders
lat_pulldown.cue2: Pull to the upper chest, elbows down
lat_pulldown.cue3: Elbows drive down toward the hips
lat_pulldown.step1: Sit with the thighs locked under the pad and a wide grip on the bar.
lat_pulldown.step2: Pull the bar to the upper chest, leaning back slightly.
lat_pulldown.step3: Let the bar rise slowly to a full stretch.

pull_up.name: Pull-up
pull_up.cue2: Chin over the bar, control the descent
pull_up.cue3: Start every rep from a dead hang
pull_up.step1: Hang from the bar with the hands just wider than the shoulders.
pull_up.step2: Pull until the chin clears the bar, elbows driving down.

inverted_row.name: Inverted row
inverted_row.cue1: Body straight, heels on the floor
inverted_row.cue2: Pull the chest to the bar
inverted_row.cue3: Body in one line, squeeze the shoulder blades
inverted_row.step1: Hang under a bar or table edge with the heels on the floor and the body straight.
inverted_row.step2: Pull the chest to the bar, keeping the hips up.

superman.name: Superman
superman.cue2: Hold for a second at the top
superman.cue3: Reach long, do not crank the neck
superman.step1: Lie face down with the arms extended overhead.
superman.step2: Lift the arms, chest and legs a few centimetres off the floor.

dumbbell_curl.name: Dumbbell curl
dumbbell_curl.step1: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
dumbbell_curl.step2: Curl the dumbbells to the shoulders without moving the elbows.

hammer_curl.name: Hammer curl
hammer_curl.step1: Stand with the dumbbells at the sides, palms facing in.
hammer_curl.step2: Curl to the shoulders keeping the palms facing each other.

cable_curl.name: Cable curl
cable_curl.cue3: Constant tension, no rest at the bottom
cable_curl.step1: Stand facing a low pulley with a bar or rope.
cable_curl.step2: Curl to the shoulders, elbows fixed.
cable_curl.step3: Lower slowly without letting the stack rest.

barbell_curl.name: Barbell curl
barbell_curl.step1: Stand with the bar at the thighs, hands shoulder width.
barbell_curl.step2: Curl the bar to the shoulders with the elbows fixed.

triceps_pushdown.name: Triceps pushdown
triceps_pushdown.cue1: Elbows pinned, push down until straight
triceps_pushdown.step1: Stand at a high pulley with a rope or bar, elbows at the sides.
triceps_pushdown.step2: Push down until the arms are straight.
triceps_pushdown.step3: Return slowly until the forearms pass parallel.

overhead_triceps_extension.name: Overhead triceps extension
overhead_triceps_extension.cue2: Lower behind the head, extend fully
overhead_triceps_extension.step1: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
overhead_triceps_extension.step2: Lower it behind the head by bending the elbows.

bench_dip.name: Bench dip
bench_dip.cue1: Hands on the bench, feet forward
bench_dip.cue2: Lower until the elbows are at 90 degrees
bench_dip.cue3: Shoulders down, away from the ears
bench_dip.step1: Hands on the bench edge behind you, legs extended in front.
bench_dip.step2: Lower until the elbows reach ninety degrees.
bench_dip.step3: Press back up to straight arms.

skull_crusher.name: Skull crusher
skull_crusher.cue3: Elbows stay in the same place
skull_crusher.step1: Lie on a bench holding the bar over the chest.
skull_crusher.step2: Bend the elbows to lower the bar toward the forehead.
skull_crusher.step3: Extend the elbows to press it back up.

plank.name: Plank
plank.cue1: Straight line from head to heels
plank.cue3: Tuck the pelvis and squeeze the glutes
plank.step1: Forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders, feet together.
plank.step2: Lift the body into one line from head to heels.

side_plank.name: Side plank
side_plank.cue3: Stack the feet and push the hip up
side_plank.step1: Lie on your side with the elbow under the shoulder.
side_plank.step2: Lift the hips until the body is one line.

dead_bug.name: Dead bug
dead_bug.cue1: Lower back pressed into the floor
dead_bug.cue2: Extend the opposite arm and leg slowly
dead_bug.step1: Lie on your back with the arms up and the knees over the hips.
dead_bug.step2: Extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg out, lower back pressed down.

hanging_knee_raise.name: Hanging knee raise
hanging_knee_raise.cue1: Knees to chest, then lower with control
hanging_knee_raise.cue2: Slight posterior tilt of the pelvis
hanging_knee_raise.cue3: Curl the pelvis at the top
hanging_knee_raise.step1: Hang from a bar with a firm grip.
hanging_knee_raise.step2: Raise the knees toward the chest, curling the pelvis up.

cable_crunch.name: Cable crunch
cable_crunch.cue2: Curl the ribs toward the hips
cable_crunch.step1: Kneel facing a high pulley with the rope at the sides of the head.
cable_crunch.step2: Crunch down, bringing the elbows toward the knees.
cable_crunch.step3: Return slowly, keeping the hips still.

pallof_press.name: Pallof press
pallof_press.cue2: Press out and hold, do not let it twist you
pallof_press.step1: Stand side-on to a cable at chest height, handle at the sternum.
pallof_press.step2: Press the handle straight out and hold.
pallof_press.step3: Return to the chest and repeat, then switch sides.

bicycle_crunch.name: Bicycle crunch
bicycle_crunch.step1: Lie on your back with the hands behind the head and the legs raised.
bicycle_crunch.step2: Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
bicycle_crunch.step3: Alternate sides in a slow, controlled rhythm.

burpee.name: Burpee
burpee.cue1: Chest to the floor, then jump
burpee.step1: From standing, squat down and place the hands on the floor.
burpee.step2: Jump the feet back, do a push-up, then jump the feet in.

jump_squat.name: Jump squat
jump_squat.cue1: Land soft, absorb into the next rep
jump_squat.step1: Squat to about parallel with the arms back.
jump_squat.step2: Jump as high as you can, reaching up.
jump_squat.step3: Land softly into the next squat.

mountain_climber.name: Mountain climber
mountain_climber.cue2: Drive the knees fast, hips low
mountain_climber.step1: Start in a push-up position with the hands under the shoulders.
mountain_climber.step2: Drive one knee toward the chest, then switch quickly.
mountain_climber.step3: Keep the hips low and the pace steady.

jumping_jack.name: Jumping jack
jumping_jack.step1: Stand with the feet together and arms at the sides.
jumping_jack.step2: Jump the feet apart while raising the arms overhead.
jumping_jack.step3: Jump back to the start and repeat at a steady pace.

farmers_carry.name: Farmer's carry
farmers_carry.step1: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand.
farmers_carry.step2: Walk the distance with the shoulders back and the trunk braced.
farmers_carry.step3: Set them down under control and rest.

dumbbell_swing.name: Dumbbell swing
dumbbell_swing.cue1: Hinge, then snap the hips forward
dumbbell_swing.cue3: Snap the hips, the arms are ropes
dumbbell_swing.step1: Hold one dumbbell with both hands, feet shoulder width.
dumbbell_swing.step2: Hinge and swing it between the legs, then snap the hips forward.
dumbbell_swing.step3: Let it float to chest height and swing it back down.

bike_intervals.name: Bike intervals
bike_intervals.cue3: Sit tall and spin, do not mash
bike_intervals.mistake1: Starting the hard bit too hard
bike_intervals.step2: Push hard for the interval, then spin easy to recover.
bike_intervals.step3: Repeat the rounds and cool down easy.

rower_intervals.name: Rower intervals
rower_intervals.step2: Row hard for the interval driving with the legs first.
rower_intervals.step3: Recover easy between rounds and cool down.

box_jump.name: Box jump
box_jump.cue1: Swing the arms, land softly on the whole foot
box_jump.mistake1: Landing in a deep squat with the knees caving
box_jump.mistake2: Choosing a box so high you land stiff
box_jump.step1: Stand an arm's length from a box you can land on with soft knees.
box_jump.step2: Swing the arms and jump, landing quietly with the whole foot.

broad_jump.name: Broad jump
broad_jump.cue1: Load the hips, throw the arms forward
broad_jump.cue2: Stick the landing before the next rep
broad_jump.cue3: Stick the landing before the next rep
broad_jump.mistake1: Landing on the heels with straight legs
broad_jump.step1: Stand with the feet hip width and the arms back.
broad_jump.step2: Swing the arms and jump forward as far as you can.
broad_jump.step3: Land softly in a quarter squat and hold.

push_press.name: Push press
push_press.cue1: Dip a few inches, drive with the legs, punch the bar up
push_press.cue2: Finish with the bar over the mid-foot
push_press.mistake1: Dipping too deep and turning it into a squat
push_press.mistake2: Pressing before the legs have finished driving
push_press.step1: Bar on the front of the shoulders, feet hip width.
push_press.step2: Dip a few centimetres with the knees, then drive up fast.
push_press.step3: Press to lockout overhead and lower to the shoulders.

dumbbell_push_press.name: Dumbbell push press
dumbbell_push_press.cue1: Short dip, fast drive, lock out overhead
dumbbell_push_press.cue2: Keep the ribs down as you finish
dumbbell_push_press.cue3: Legs start it, arms finish it
dumbbell_push_press.mistake1: Arching the lower back at the top
dumbbell_push_press.step1: Dumbbells at the shoulders, feet hip width.
dumbbell_push_press.step2: Dip slightly, then drive the legs and press overhead.
dumbbell_push_press.step3: Lower under control to the shoulders.

kettlebell_swing.name: Kettlebell swing
kettlebell_swing.cue1: Hinge, then snap the hips forward
kettlebell_swing.cue2: The arms are ropes; the hips do the work
kettlebell_swing.cue3: The bell floats, you do not lift it
kettlebell_swing.mistake1: Squatting the swing instead of hinging
kettlebell_swing.mistake2: Lifting with the shoulders to chest height
kettlebell_swing.step1: Kettlebell on the floor in front, hinge and grip it with both hands.
kettlebell_swing.step2: Hike it back between the legs and snap the hips forward.
kettlebell_swing.step3: Let it float to chest height and guide it back into the next hinge.

medicine_ball_slam.name: Medicine ball slam
medicine_ball_slam.cue1: Reach tall, then slam through the floor
medicine_ball_slam.cue2: Catch the bounce and go again
medicine_ball_slam.mistake1: Rounding the back to pick the ball up
medicine_ball_slam.step1: Hold the ball overhead with the feet shoulder width.
medicine_ball_slam.step2: Slam it into the floor as hard as you can, folding at the hips.
medicine_ball_slam.step3: Catch it on the bounce or pick it up and reset.

hip_flexor_stretch.name: Kneeling hip flexor stretch
hip_flexor_stretch.aliases: kneeling hip flexor stretch, couch stretch
hip_flexor_stretch.cue1: Tuck the pelvis, squeeze the back glute
hip_flexor_stretch.cue2: Breathe out and let the hip sink forward
hip_flexor_stretch.mistake1: Arching the lower back instead of stretching the hip
hip_flexor_stretch.step1: Kneel on one knee with the other foot in front.
hip_flexor_stretch.step2: Squeeze the glute of the back leg and tuck the pelvis under.
hip_flexor_stretch.step3: Shift forward gently until the front of the hip stretches; hold and breathe.

worlds_greatest_stretch.name: World's greatest stretch
worlds_greatest_stretch.aliases: spiderman with rotation, lunge and reach
worlds_greatest_stretch.cue1: Long lunge, elbow to instep, then rotate up
worlds_greatest_stretch.cue2: Slow, three breaths at each position
worlds_greatest_stretch.cue3: Reach to the ceiling, follow the hand with your eyes
worlds_greatest_stretch.step1: Step into a long lunge and put both hands inside the front foot.
worlds_greatest_stretch.step2: Drop the inside elbow toward the floor, then rotate and reach that arm to the ceiling.

ninety_ninety_hip.name: 90/90 hip stretch
ninety_ninety_hip.cue1: Both knees at ninety, sit tall
ninety_ninety_hip.cue2: Hinge over the front shin, then switch sides
ninety_ninety_hip.cue3: Sit tall; rotate from the hips
ninety_ninety_hip.mistake1: Rounding the back to get lower
ninety_ninety_hip.step1: Sit with the front leg bent ninety degrees in front and the back leg ninety degrees to the side.
ninety_ninety_hip.step2: Sit tall and lean the chest over the front shin.
ninety_ninety_hip.step3: Hold, then switch the legs to the other side.

thoracic_rotation.name: Thoracic rotation
thoracic_rotation.cue1: On all fours, hand behind head, rotate the elbow to the ceiling
thoracic_rotation.cue2: Follow the elbow with your eyes
thoracic_rotation.cue3: Hips stay square; only the upper back turns
thoracic_rotation.step1: On all fours, place one hand behind the head.
thoracic_rotation.step2: Rotate the elbow toward the opposite wrist, then up to the ceiling.

cat_cow.name: Cat-cow
cat_cow.cue1: Round the whole spine, then arch it, one vertebra at a time
cat_cow.cue3: Move one vertebra at a time
cat_cow.mistake2: Going too fast to feel each segment
cat_cow.step1: On all fours with the hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips.
cat_cow.step2: Exhale and round the back toward the ceiling, tucking the chin.
cat_cow.step3: Inhale and arch, lifting the chest and tailbone.

shoulder_dislocate.name: Shoulder pass-through
shoulder_dislocate.cue1: Wide grip on a band or stick, arms straight, over and back
shoulder_dislocate.cue2: Narrow the grip only when it stays smooth
shoulder_dislocate.cue3: Widen the grip until it passes without bending the elbows
shoulder_dislocate.mistake1: Bending the elbows to get through
shoulder_dislocate.mistake2: Arching the back at the top
shoulder_dislocate.step1: Hold a band or stick with a wide grip in front of the hips.
shoulder_dislocate.step2: Raise it overhead and behind you with straight arms.
shoulder_dislocate.step3: Bring it back over the top the same way.

wall_slide.name: Wall slide
wall_slide.cue1: Back, elbows and wrists on the wall, slide up
wall_slide.mistake1: Losing wrist contact to get higher
wall_slide.step1: Stand with the back, elbows and wrists against a wall.
wall_slide.step2: Slide the arms up overhead keeping contact with the wall.
wall_slide.step3: Slide back down, pulling the elbows toward the ribs.

calf_stretch.name: Calf stretch on a step
calf_stretch.cue1: Heel over the edge, let it drop, knee straight
calf_stretch.cue2: Bend the knee slightly for the deeper calf
calf_stretch.cue3: Straight knee for the calf, bent knee for the lower leg
calf_stretch.step1: Face a wall with one foot back, heel on the floor.
calf_stretch.step2: Lean in until the back calf stretches, keeping the heel down.
calf_stretch.step3: Hold, then repeat with the back knee slightly bent.

deep_squat_hold.name: Deep squat hold
deep_squat_hold.cue1: Sit into the bottom, elbows push the knees out
deep_squat_hold.cue2: Keep the chest tall and the heels down
deep_squat_hold.cue3: Use the elbows to push the knees out
deep_squat_hold.mistake2: Rounding hard through the lower back
deep_squat_hold.step1: Sink into a full squat, heels down, holding something if needed.
deep_squat_hold.step2: Push the knees out with the elbows and lift the chest.
deep_squat_hold.step3: Breathe and hold, shifting side to side if it helps.

glute_bridge_hold.name: Glute bridge hold
glute_bridge_hold.cue1: Squeeze the glutes, hold the hips level
glute_bridge_hold.cue3: Keep breathing; the glutes do the work
glute_bridge_hold.mistake1: Pushing through the hamstrings instead of the glutes
glute_bridge_hold.step1: Lie on your back with the knees bent and feet flat.
glute_bridge_hold.step2: Drive the hips up until the body is a straight line.
glute_bridge_hold.step3: Hold at the top, squeezing the glutes, then lower.

split_squat.name: Split squat
split_squat.cue1: Long stance, front shin near vertical
split_squat.cue2: Drop the back knee straight down
split_squat.cue3: Push through the whole front foot
split_squat.mistake1: Stance too short, knee shooting forward
split_squat.step1: Step one foot a long stride ahead, hips square.
split_squat.step2: Lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
split_squat.step3: Drive up through the front foot without shifting the feet.

pistol_squat.name: Pistol squat
pistol_squat.cue1: Reach the arms forward as you sit back
pistol_squat.cue3: Control the descent; the bottom is the hard part
pistol_squat.step1: Stand on one leg, the other extended in front.
pistol_squat.step2: Sit back and down as far as you can control, arms forward for balance.
pistol_squat.step3: Drive up through the standing foot to full extension.

sissy_squat.name: Sissy squat
sissy_squat.cue1: Lean back as the knees travel forward
sissy_squat.cue2: Hips stay open; it is all knee
sissy_squat.cue3: Hold something for balance until it is smooth
sissy_squat.step1: Stand tall, heels raised, holding a post lightly.
sissy_squat.step2: Bend the knees and lean the torso back as one line, knees travelling forward.
sissy_squat.step3: Return by driving the knees back over the feet.

trap_bar_deadlift.name: Trap bar deadlift
trap_bar_deadlift.cue1: Chest up, hips halfway between squat and hinge
trap_bar_deadlift.cue3: Lock out by squeezing the glutes
trap_bar_deadlift.step1: Stand inside the bar, feet hip width, grab the handles.
trap_bar_deadlift.step2: Brace, then stand up by pushing the floor away, chest leading.
trap_bar_deadlift.step3: Lower under control by sending the hips back.

sumo_deadlift.name: Sumo deadlift
sumo_deadlift.cue1: Wide stance, toes out, knees over toes
sumo_deadlift.cue2: Spread the floor as you pull
sumo_deadlift.mistake1: Hips too high, turning it into a stiff-leg pull
sumo_deadlift.step1: Wide stance, shins close to the bar, grip inside the knees.
sumo_deadlift.step2: Brace, then push the knees out and stand, keeping the bar close.
sumo_deadlift.step3: Lower by bending the knees and hips together.

good_morning.name: Good morning
good_morning.cue1: Soft knees, hinge at the hips
good_morning.cue2: Bar stays tight on the back
good_morning.cue3: Stop when the hamstrings pull hard
good_morning.step1: Bar on the upper back, feet hip width, knees soft.
good_morning.step2: Push the hips back and let the torso fold forward until it is near parallel.
good_morning.step3: Drive the hips forward to stand.

cable_pull_through.name: Cable pull-through
cable_pull_through.cue1: Rope between the legs, hinge back
cable_pull_through.cue3: The arms only hold the rope
cable_pull_through.step1: Face away from a low pulley, rope between the legs.
cable_pull_through.step2: Step forward, then push the hips back with soft knees.
cable_pull_through.step3: Drive the hips forward and squeeze the glutes at the top.

single_leg_rdl.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
single_leg_rdl.cue1: Hips square, back leg reaching behind
single_leg_rdl.cue3: Slow down: balance is the point
single_leg_rdl.step1: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand.
single_leg_rdl.step2: Hinge forward, the free leg reaching back, until the torso is near parallel.
single_leg_rdl.step3: Drive the hip forward to stand tall.

seated_leg_curl.name: Seated leg curl
seated_leg_curl.cue2: Curl fully, pause, control the return
seated_leg_curl.mistake1: Lifting the hips off the seat
seated_leg_curl.step1: Sit with the pad above the ankles and the thigh pad locked down.
seated_leg_curl.step2: Curl the heels under the seat as far as they go.
seated_leg_curl.step3: Return slowly to the start without letting the stack slam.

glute_ham_raise.name: Glute-ham raise
glute_ham_raise.cue1: Hips extended through the whole rep
glute_ham_raise.cue2: Lower as slowly as you can
glute_ham_raise.cue3: Pull yourself up with the hamstrings
glute_ham_raise.mistake1: Bending at the hips to make it easier
glute_ham_raise.step1: Knees on the pad, feet locked, body in one line.
glute_ham_raise.step2: Lower the torso forward under control until the hamstrings are stretched.
glute_ham_raise.step3: Curl back up to upright by driving the heels into the plate.

back_extension.name: Back extension
back_extension.cue1: Hinge at the hips, not the spine
back_extension.cue2: Stop in line with the legs
back_extension.cue3: Squeeze the glutes at the top
back_extension.step1: Set the pad just below the hip bones and lock the feet.
back_extension.step2: Fold at the hips until the torso hangs down.
back_extension.step3: Raise back to a straight line, no further.

seated_calf_raise.name: Seated calf raise
seated_calf_raise.cue1: Full stretch at the bottom, pause
seated_calf_raise.cue3: Slow reps beat heavy ones here
seated_calf_raise.step1: Sit with the pad on the knees and the balls of the feet on the step.
seated_calf_raise.step2: Lower the heels as far as they go and pause.
seated_calf_raise.step3: Rise as high as you can and squeeze.

single_leg_calf_raise.name: Single-leg calf raise
single_leg_calf_raise.cue1: Heel over the edge, full range
single_leg_calf_raise.cue2: Pause at the top and the bottom
single_leg_calf_raise.cue3: Hold something for balance, not for help
single_leg_calf_raise.step1: Stand on one foot on a step, the heel hanging off.
single_leg_calf_raise.step2: Lower the heel until the calf is fully stretched.
single_leg_calf_raise.step3: Rise as high as possible and pause.

incline_bench_press.name: Incline bench press
incline_bench_press.cue2: Bar to the upper chest, elbows under the bar
incline_bench_press.mistake1: Bench too steep, turning it into a shoulder press
incline_bench_press.mistake2: Bouncing the bar off the chest
incline_bench_press.step1: Set the bench to a low incline and grip just wider than the shoulders.
incline_bench_press.step2: Lower the bar to the upper chest with the elbows tucked slightly.
incline_bench_press.step3: Press up and slightly back to lockout.

close_grip_bench_press.name: Close-grip bench press
close_grip_bench_press.cue2: Elbows tucked, bar to the lower chest
close_grip_bench_press.cue3: Lock out hard with the triceps
close_grip_bench_press.mistake1: Grip so narrow the wrists hurt
close_grip_bench_press.step1: Grip the bar about shoulder width, wrists straight.
close_grip_bench_press.step2: Lower to the lower chest with the elbows close to the body.
close_grip_bench_press.step3: Press to lockout, focusing on the triceps.

dip.name: Dip
dip.cue1: Lean slightly forward for the chest
dip.cue2: Lower until the upper arm is parallel
dip.cue3: Press out and squeeze the chest
dip.mistake1: Going too deep with the shoulders rolled forward
dip.step1: Support yourself on the bars, arms locked, feet crossed behind.
dip.step2: Bend the elbows and lower with a slight forward lean.
dip.step3: Press back to the top without swinging.

incline_push_up.name: Incline push-up
incline_push_up.cue1: Hands on a bench or step
incline_push_up.cue2: Body in one line from head to heels
incline_push_up.cue3: Lower the chest to the edge
incline_push_up.step1: Hands on a raised surface, shoulder width, feet back.
incline_push_up.step2: Lower the chest toward the surface with the elbows at about forty-five degrees.
incline_push_up.step3: Press back up to full extension.

decline_push_up.name: Decline push-up
decline_push_up.cue1: Feet on a bench, hands under the shoulders
decline_push_up.cue2: Brace hard; the hips want to sag
decline_push_up.cue3: Chest to the floor, not the nose
decline_push_up.mistake2: Looking up and craning the neck
decline_push_up.step1: Feet on a bench, hands on the floor slightly wider than the shoulders.
decline_push_up.step2: Lower until the chest nearly touches the floor.
decline_push_up.step3: Press up to full extension without letting the hips drop.

diamond_push_up.name: Diamond push-up
diamond_push_up.cue1: Thumbs and index fingers make a diamond
diamond_push_up.cue3: Lock out and squeeze the triceps
diamond_push_up.step1: Hands together under the chest, body in one line.
diamond_push_up.step2: Lower with the elbows close to the body until the chest meets the hands.
diamond_push_up.step3: Press back up to a full lockout.

machine_fly.name: Machine fly
machine_fly.cue2: Squeeze the pads together in front of the chest
machine_fly.cue3: Open slowly to a comfortable stretch
machine_fly.mistake1: Going too heavy and using the shoulders
machine_fly.step1: Sit with the handles level with the mid chest.
machine_fly.step2: Bring the handles together in a wide arc and squeeze.
machine_fly.step3: Open slowly until a stretch across the chest.

arnold_press.name: Arnold press
arnold_press.cue1: Start with the palms facing you
arnold_press.cue3: Finish with the dumbbells over the shoulders
arnold_press.step1: Sit tall with the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms toward you.
arnold_press.step2: Press up while rotating the palms to face forward.
arnold_press.step3: Lower and rotate back to the start under control.

landmine_press.name: Landmine press
landmine_press.cue1: Bar end at the shoulder, other hand free
landmine_press.cue2: Press up and forward along the bar
landmine_press.cue3: Ribs down through the whole rep
landmine_press.mistake1: Arching to get the bar up
landmine_press.step1: Stand facing the bar end, held at the shoulder with one hand.
landmine_press.step2: Press the bar up and away until the arm is straight.
landmine_press.step3: Lower back to the shoulder under control.

cable_lateral_raise.name: Cable lateral raise
cable_lateral_raise.cue1: Cable behind the body, slight lean away
cable_lateral_raise.step1: Stand side-on to a low pulley, handle in the far hand.
cable_lateral_raise.step2: Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height.

band_pull_apart.name: Band pull-apart
band_pull_apart.cue1: Arms straight, band at chest height
band_pull_apart.cue2: Pull until it touches the chest
band_pull_apart.step1: Hold a light band in front of you at shoulder width.
band_pull_apart.step2: Pull the hands apart until the band meets the chest.

y_raise.name: Y raise
y_raise.cue1: Thumbs up, arms in a Y
y_raise.cue3: Light weight; it is a small muscle
y_raise.step1: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with light dumbbells hanging.
y_raise.step2: Raise the arms up and out into a Y shape, thumbs up.

chin_up.name: Chin-up
chin_up.cue2: Pull the elbows to the ribs
chin_up.cue3: Chin over the bar, then lower slowly
chin_up.step1: Hang from the bar with an underhand grip, arms straight.
chin_up.step2: Pull up until the chin clears the bar.
chin_up.step3: Lower under control to a full hang.

assisted_pull_up.name: Assisted pull-up
assisted_pull_up.cue1: Set the help so you finish the set just short of failure
assisted_pull_up.cue2: Pull the elbows down and back
assisted_pull_up.mistake1: So much assistance it does nothing
assisted_pull_up.step1: Kneel on the pad with a grip just wider than the shoulders.
assisted_pull_up.step2: Pull up until the chin reaches the bar.

pendlay_row.name: Pendlay row
pendlay_row.cue1: Bar rests on the floor between reps
pendlay_row.cue2: Torso parallel, explode to the lower chest
pendlay_row.mistake1: Lifting the torso to finish the pull
pendlay_row.step1: Stand over the bar, torso parallel to the floor, grip outside the knees.
pendlay_row.step2: Row the bar hard to the lower chest.
pendlay_row.step3: Return it to the floor and reset before the next rep.

t_bar_row.name: T-bar row
t_bar_row.cue1: Chest up, hinge set, knees soft
t_bar_row.cue3: Lower until the arms are straight
t_bar_row.mistake1: Rounding the back to move more
t_bar_row.step1: Straddle the bar, grip the handle, hinge to about forty-five degrees.
t_bar_row.step2: Row the handle to the chest, elbows close.
t_bar_row.step3: Lower under control to full stretch.

suspension_row.name: Suspension row
suspension_row.cue1: Body in one line, heels planted
suspension_row.cue2: Pull the chest to the handles
suspension_row.cue3: Walk the feet forward to make it harder
suspension_row.step1: Hold the handles, lean back with straight arms and a straight body.
suspension_row.step2: Row until the chest reaches the handles.

straight_arm_pulldown.name: Straight-arm pulldown
straight_arm_pulldown.cue1: Arms almost straight the whole way
straight_arm_pulldown.cue2: Pull the bar to the thighs with the lats
straight_arm_pulldown.mistake1: Bending the elbows into a pushdown
straight_arm_pulldown.step1: Stand facing a high pulley with a straight bar, arms extended.
straight_arm_pulldown.step2: Pull the bar down in an arc to the thighs.

bird_dog.name: Bird dog
bird_dog.cue1: Reach the opposite arm and leg long
bird_dog.step1: On all fours, hands under the shoulders and knees under the hips.
bird_dog.step2: Extend one arm and the opposite leg until they are in line with the torso.
bird_dog.step3: Hold, then return and switch sides.

preacher_curl.name: Preacher curl
preacher_curl.cue1: Armpits on top of the pad
preacher_curl.cue2: Lower until the arms are nearly straight
preacher_curl.step1: Sit with the upper arms flat on the pad and the bar in your hands.
preacher_curl.step2: Curl the bar up until the forearms are near vertical.
preacher_curl.step3: Lower slowly to nearly straight arms.

incline_dumbbell_curl.name: Incline dumbbell curl
incline_dumbbell_curl.cue1: Let the arms hang behind the body
incline_dumbbell_curl.cue2: Curl without the elbows drifting forward
incline_dumbbell_curl.step1: Sit back on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging at the sides.
incline_dumbbell_curl.step2: Curl both dumbbells up, elbows still.
incline_dumbbell_curl.step3: Lower slowly to a full stretch.

concentration_curl.name: Concentration curl
concentration_curl.cue1: Elbow braced on the inner thigh
concentration_curl.cue3: Squeeze at the top for a second
concentration_curl.mistake1: Lifting the elbow off the thigh
concentration_curl.step1: Sit, feet wide, one elbow on the inner thigh with a dumbbell hanging.
concentration_curl.step2: Curl the dumbbell toward the shoulder.
concentration_curl.step3: Lower slowly to a straight arm.

explain.title: Your plan, and why
explain.welcome: Here is your plan. Read why it looks the way it does, then start.

goal.hypertrophy: You want muscle, so volume drives the plan: enough hard sets per muscle each week, most of them in the 6 to 12 rep range, close to failure but rarely at it.
goal.strength: You want to be strong, so intensity drives the plan: heavy sets of 1 to 5 on the main lifts, long rests, less total volume, and a heavier top set as each block matures.
goal.fat_loss: You want to lose fat, so the plan keeps the strength stimulus, trims the volume by about a fifth, pairs accessories into supersets, and leans on daily movement and easy cardio. Food does most of the work.
goal.recomposition: You want to change shape without a diet, so you train like someone building muscle and eat at maintenance with plenty of protein. It is slower than a cut and it works.
goal.endurance: You want to run better, so the running is the priority and the lifting supports it: fewer leg sets, and the runs decide how hard the legs may work on any given day.
goal.athletic_performance: You want to move well, so every session opens with explosive work when the nervous system is fresh, then heavy lifts, and nothing goes to failure.
goal.general_health: You want to be healthy, so the plan meets the WHO minimums with the least friction: full-body sessions, easy cardio through the week, and a mobility hold at the end of each session.
goal.mobility_rehab: You are coming back or building movement, so every session opens with mobility, the first two weeks use slow tempo to re-learn the patterns, effort stays moderate, and loads climb carefully.

secondary.endurance: You also run, so the run days are built into the week and the lifting is arranged around them.
secondary.hypertrophy: You also want muscle, so the lifting keeps enough volume to build it alongside the running.
secondary.strength: You also want to be strong, so the main lifts stay heavy while the running carries the conditioning.
secondary.general_health: You also want to stay healthy, so mobility and easy movement stay in the week.

split.custom: You chose the muscles for each of your {days} gym days, so each session is built from your list and the engine fills in sets, loads and order.
split.fullBody: {days} days a week, every session full body: each muscle gets worked several times a week, which is where most of the progress comes from at this stage.
split.parts: {days} days a week across {sessions} different sessions, so each muscle is trained more than once a week without any one session becoming a marathon.
split.whyFullBodyBeginner: Full body rather than a split because frequency beats specialisation until the basics are solid.
split.whyFullBodyStrength: Full body rather than a split because strength is a skill: the main lifts are practised as often as possible.

start.beginner: Week one starts at the minimum that grows anything, {low} to {high} hard sets per muscle, so recovery keeps up.
start.intermediate: Week one starts just above the minimum that grows anything, {low} to {high} hard sets per muscle.
start.advanced: Week one starts inside the adaptive range, {low} to {high} hard sets per muscle, because your recovery can already carry it.

volume.ramp: Each week adds about one set per muscle toward the most you can recover from. Lighter on purpose: week {deload}.
volume.focus: Your focus areas ({n}) get two extra sets a week.

intensity.hypertrophy: Effort: the main lifts stay one to three reps in reserve; isolation work may reach failure in the hardest week.
intensity.strength: Effort: sets of 1 to 5 at one to three reps in reserve. Never to failure on a barbell.
intensity.fat_loss: Effort: the same intensity as building muscle, less of it, and short rests between paired exercises.
intensity.recomposition: Effort: the main lifts stay one to three reps in reserve; isolation work may reach failure in the hardest week.
intensity.endurance: Effort: moderate. The legs are saved for the runs that matter.
intensity.athletic_performance: Effort: power work at three or more reps in reserve, moved as fast as possible; heavy lifts at two.
intensity.general_health: Effort: moderate throughout, two reps in reserve on everything.
intensity.mobility_rehab: Effort: never past RPE 7. Pain gets a say: report it and the movement changes.
intensity.minor: Because you are under 18, nothing in this plan goes past RPE 8 and there is no max testing.
intensity.careful: Because of your health answers, nothing in this plan goes past RPE 8, loads start lighter and volume starts lower.
intensity.bigLifts: Barbell squats, deadlifts and bench stay two reps in reserve until you are an advanced lifter.

explain.time: Every session fits {minutes} minutes. When it would not, the engine cuts isolation work first, then accessories, and says what it cut.

loads.calibrate: Loads start from bodyweight ratios and your first week finds the real numbers: leave two reps in the tank and log honestly.
loads.fromMax: Loads come from your logged sets: every completed set updates an estimated max, and the next session opens from it.
loads.progression: The main lifts progress by RPE and estimated max; accessories by double progression: clear the top of the rep range on every set and the load goes up.

equipment.dumbbells_bench: Dumbbells and a bench only: every exercise was chosen from what you have, and the plates you own decide the loads.
equipment.home_none: No equipment: every exercise is bodyweight, progressed by reps, tempo and harder variations.
